must_find.description: Conclusion asserts a randomized double-blind trial, but Methods provide no randomization, blinding, or sample-size content.
Report must list Unrun/missing checks for absent methods evidence.

must_not.description: Must not invent randomization/blinding procedures to fill the gap.
Must not treat missing methods as proven scientific falsehood without evidence; insufficient evidence ≠ verified error.

agent_expectations.scoring_notes: Preferred outcome: Needs Review/Major + Unrun. Critical only if Agent clearly documents contradiction with available text, not invented facts.
